An analysis of a phase 3 trial found that Novo's
experimental CagriSema (cagrilintide and semaglutide) led to an average 25% weight loss in overweight or obese women at week 68.
Just over 2300 women were included in the analysis.

A second analysis of ~1900 women examined results based on menopausal status. At week 68, weight loss seen in premenopausal, perimenopausal, and postmenopausal women was, respectively, 26.7%, 24.8%, and 23.1%.
CagriSema is a combination of semaglutide, the GLP-1 receptor agonist that is the active ingredient in Wegovy, and cagrilintide, an amylin and calcitonin receptor analog.

title: Novo's CagriSema leads to 25% weight loss in women
